info.title: Parallax API
info.description: Backend API for manually submitted Parallax missions. External writes are proposed, approved, executed, verified, and audited by deterministic backend services.

get.description:
Merged, chronological mission timeline.

Every durable trace of what happened inside one mission, in order:
status transitions, knowledge-base facts, action executions,
verifications, and approval decisions.

post.summary: Park a mission until an external event arrives
post.description:
K4.3: a mission waiting for an external change consumes no worker.

The mission parks in WAITING_FOR_EVENT; the event router wakes it when
a matching external event arrives.

WEBHOOK_SECRET is set.
